gameProximity.title: Proximity
gameProximity.intro: A hidden figure awaits. Guess any person, and we'll tell you how close they are to the answer. Use the temperature to narrow it down.
gameProximity.mobileRule: Search and guess a figure. Temperature and axis hints guide you closer.
gameProximity.fixtureNotice: Demo mode: Running on sample data. Distance is calculated using era, region, and profession only (no spectrum scores).

rules.guessBody: Guess any historical or notable figure. You have up to 15 attempts.
rules.hintsBody: Each guess reveals a temperature (0–100) plus axis hints for era, region, profession, and spectrum.
rules.narrowBody: Combine the hints to close in. This is a deduction game, not a knowledge test.
